description: This file defines API endpoints for interacting with API logs, including retrieving logs, statistics, endpoint information, and clearing logs. It uses FastAPI and Pydantic models to structure the API.

classes.name: APICallLog
classes.description: Model representing a single API call log entry with detailed request and response information.

classes.name: APIStats
classes.description: Model representing aggregated API usage statistics.

classes.name: APIEndpointInfo
classes.description: Model representing information about a specific API endpoint, including method, path, summary, description, tags, and parameters.

methods.name: get_api_calls( limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=1000, description="Maximum number of calls to return"), method: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by HTTP method"), path: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by endpoint path (contains)"), status_code: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Filter by status code"), success_only: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter successful calls only") )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve recent API call logs with filtering options.

methods.name: get_api_stats()
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve aggregated API usage statistics.

methods.name: get_available_endpoints()
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve information about all registered API endpoints.

methods.name: clear_api_logs()
methods.description: Endpoint to clear all stored API call logs.
